moduleReset.title: Reset {{moduleName}} Data

templateGenPurge.title: Permanently delete org doc gen data
templateGenPurge.description: Delete template data for {{orgName}}. This is restricted to organization-owned template gen data.
templateGenPurge.cardDescription: Permanently remove soft-deleted or all organization-owned doc gen templates, versions, generations, and generated files for this organization.
templateGenPurge.warningBody: The cleanup permanently deletes template definitions, uploaded template versions, generation history, and generated output files for the selected scope.
templateGenPurge.scopeSoftDeletedHint: Recommended. Only templates already soft-deleted for this organization are removed permanently.
templateGenPurge.scopeAllHint: Deletes every organization-owned doc gen template in this organization, including active ones.
templateGenPurge.confirmHint: The action stays disabled until the exact word DELETE is entered.
templateGenPurge.success: Deleted {{templates}} templates, {{versions}} versions, {{generations}} generations, and {{files}} generated files.
templateGenPurge.deleteFailed: Could not delete the doc gen data.

orgReset.title: Permanently reset organization data
orgReset.description: Delete operational data for {{orgName}}. Choose what to preserve below; the organization shell, settings, and signed-in members are always kept.
orgReset.cardDescription: Permanently remove org-owned operational data. You can preserve each resettable module independently.
orgReset.warningBody: Turning off a module includes it in the reset scope. The organization record and settings are always kept. Member accounts (org memberships and profiles) are never deleted here, but invitation records can still be removed when that module is not preserved.
orgReset.preserveModulesHint: Each module can be kept or deleted separately. For example, you can wipe calendar data without removing staff records.
orgReset.noModules: No resettable modules are available for this organization.
orgReset.preserveStaffHint: Keeps staff members, teams, leave records, planner assignments, and related staff tables for this organization.
orgReset.preserveDocProcessingHint: Keeps flows, templates, mappings, bindings, and other doc-processing setup (jobs tied to deleted entities may still be cleaned up indirectly).
orgReset.preserveInvitationsHint: Keeps open invitations and magic invite links. Turn off to wipe onboarding artifacts only; member accounts stay.
orgReset.membersNeverDeletedHint: Organization memberships and user profiles are never removed by this reset.
orgReset.keptHint: Use the checkboxes above to control which setup modules stay out of the delete scope.
orgReset.confirmHint: The action stays disabled until the exact word DELETE is entered.
orgReset.success: Deleted {{count}} rows from the organization reset scope.
orgReset.previewFailed: Could not load the organization reset preview.
orgReset.deleteFailed: Could not reset the organization data.
